title: Nebulink
problem: NebuLink addresses the issue of inadequate access to education and user-friendly trading tools in the stock and cryptocurrency markets, offering a solution for users who struggle with limited educational resources, data overload, complex trading platforms, security concerns, and the need for risk-free practice opportunities.
overview: NebuLink is a comprehensive mobile trading and educational app designed to empower users with the tools and knowledge necessary for successful trading in both traditional stocks and cryptocurrencies. NebuLink offers a user-friendly and intuitive interface, making it accessible to both beginner and experienced traders.
role: Conducted user research and usability testing to understand and validate users' pain points.
Designed platform assets from zero to one, using an agile process to iterate continuously.
Worked as the sole designer using Figma.
contribution: Research, Branding, Usability testing, UX/UI Design, Prototypes.

sections.title: The project

blocks.heading: The goal — Design an app that will:

list: Provide guided onboarding and educational content that helps beginners use the platform and make informed trading decisions.
Maintain a consistent visual identity throughout the app to build trust and recognition.
Present market data and educational content clearly to prevent information overload.

blocks: NebuLink demonstrates the value of a trading platform centered on user needs and accessibility. By combining education, risk-free practice, and clear market information, the concept helps users build confidence as they navigate stocks and cryptocurrency.

list: Educational Empowerment: Combining accessible educational resources with a trading platform is powerful. Users appreciate the opportunity to learn and practice within the same ecosystem, fostering confidence and competence.
Virtual Trading Impact: A virtual trading simulator gives users a risk-free environment to refine strategies and build confidence before making real trades.
Community Building: Collaboration, discussion forums, and expert insights can add meaningful support to the trading experience.

sections.title: Understanding the user
blocks: I conducted user interviews where most interview participants reported feeling overwhelmed when it came to trading stocks and cryptocurrencies and anxious because they were not sure how the process works. The feedback received through research made it very clear that NebuLink users would appreciate a tool that simplifies the trading experience, helping them make informed decisions in the financial markets.

list: Users lacked comprehensive educational materials to build a foundation in trading, leaving them uncertain about market dynamics and strategies.

Many users found existing trading platforms too complex, leading to confusion and frustration, especially for beginners attempting to navigate the intricacies of buying and selling financial instruments.
Beginner traders found it challenging to practice without risking real money, which impeded their ability to fine-tune strategies and build confidence before entering the actual trading arena.

blocks: Alex's user journey highlighted the importance of having a NebuLink mobile app dedicated to trading, showcasing the need for a platform that caters specifically to the unique requirements of stock and cryptocurrency investors

sections.title: Design Process
blocks: Iterating through paper drafts for each screen of the NebuLink app ensured that the elements incorporated into the digital wireframes were thoughtfully designed to tackle user challenges effectively. In the home screen design, priority was given to an easy and transparent display of the status of the portfolio, as well as aiming to encourage users to explore and discover new tools and resources for trading.

sections.title: Usability Testing
blocks: During user interviews, many participants shared their struggles with the complexities of trading stocks and cryptocurrencies, feeling overwhelmed and uncertain. The feedback showed a desire for an education and community approach within NebuLink, where users could access guidance to navigate the trading landscape with ease. They emphasized the need for an intuitively designed tool to simplify the trading process and boost confidence in making informed investment decisions.

sections.title: Purchase
blocks: Buy tokens through a fast, clear, and secure flow with transparent purchase details, fees, and access to the selected bank account.

sections.title: Stock / Crypto
blocks: View performance through a clear interface with focused statistics, ratings, articles, and community discussions for each stock or cryptocurrency.

sections.title: Dashboard
blocks: Follow stocks and cryptocurrencies, discover opportunities by category, and find new articles and discussions in one focused dashboard.

list: Ensuring sufficient color contrast throughout the app to accommodate users with visual impairments and color vision deficiencies.
Designing layouts that are responsive and adaptable to different screen sizes and orientations, catering to users who may rely on various devices.
Designing forms with clear labels, error messages, and logical tab orders to assist users with disabilities in completing tasks seamlessly.
Ensuring that content is presented clearly and understandably, benefiting users with cognitive disabilities or language barriers.
Continue gathering and analyzing user feedback through surveys, usability testing, and community engagement.
Explore additional features and tools that align with user needs and industry trends.
Expand and diversify educational content to cover advanced trading strategies, market trends, and emerging technologies.
